description: Issue #1013 D-2 aggregate cap: an item over its cap promotes its cheapest-to-serialize tolerated overlap, chosen by benefit ascending before cost descending.
notes: tolerance_percent 100. Item 1 (C4, duration 8) shares modules mA and mB with item 2 (C3, duration 4): cost 2*2 = 4, benefit min(8, 4) = 4, 400 <= 400, tolerated. Round 1: item 1 is the smallest over-cap key; its overlaps (1,2) key (4, -4, 1, 2) and (1,3) key (8, -6, 1, 3); the minimum is (1,2) by benefit, although (1,3) costs more. Promote (1,2). Item 1 total = 6, 600 <= 800; no item is over its cap, so the pass stops. Promoted: (1,2). Edges: (1,2) module_overlap, hard false, cost 4, benefit 4. Tolerated: (1,3).
